title: A remote proxy that writes a central worktree under an alias path is not fenced for focused checks
outcome: A remote proxy session that can write a central worktree under a spelling the central host does not read as that worktree is counted as a possible writer there for focused checks too, or such writes are caught by watcher coverage for focused checks. Examples: a WSL /mnt/c/... workdir reached over SSH to the central machine, or a share mounted under another path. Credit is never given to a focused check such a proxy may have written under.
acceptance: A remote proxy that writes a central worktree under an alias path is not fenced for focused checks is done
